description:
Start a video export of the project. Returns immediately with an export_id;
the export renders in the background (~5 min) and the user gets the result in the
editor's Exports tab. Start it, tell the user it has started (with the export_id), and
stop: do not call get_export in a loop or hold run_script open waiting for it. Call
get_export only when the user asks for the link (it then returns download_url, or
embed_url for destination="embed").

destination:
  • "download" (default) — an mp4 file; once done, get_export returns a time-limited download_url.
  • "embed" — publish the project as an embeddable video player (the same embed the
    editor's Share → Embed creates). The embed URL is permanent: re-publishing after
    edits updates the video behind the SAME URL, so pages and LMS lessons that embed it
    update in place. Use get_embed(project_id) to read the URL and iframe code of an
    already-published project without re-rendering.

format:
  • "mp4" (default) — the video.
  • "mp3" — the project's whole soundtrack as one MP3: voiceover, music, extracted
    audio and video audio, mixed as the video plays them. Billed like a video export.
    Download only; resolution, fps and captions are ignored. There is no voiceover-only
    file: to leave music or video audio out, mute or remove it first.

Defaults: 1080p / 30fps / no captions / English. Pass overrides only when needed; a resolution or fps above the workspace's plan is capped to it.
Refused while a job (speech, sync, the build) still holds the project, since the render would catch it mid-change: export once they finish.
`captions` burns subtitles into a download; an embed instead carries captions the
viewer toggles in the player, so `captions` is ignored for destination="embed".

captions.description: Burn subtitles into the video (default false)

destination.description: Where the render goes: "download" (mp4 file, default) or "embed" (publish/update the project's embeddable player; its URL never changes). Publishing an embed needs an editor or admin role.

format.description: "mp4" (video, default) or "mp3" (the whole soundtrack, no picture; download only)

language.description: Language code of the voiceover and captions to render, e.g. 'de' for a translated project (default 'en'). Downloads only.

name: export_project
title: Export project
